summary: When creating an OperatorService from a WorkflowService channel, the grpcMetadataProvider configuration is not automatically carried over, requiring manual re-configuration.
userImpact: Users must manually re-apply gRPC metadata provider configuration when creating operator services from existing workflow service channels, causing code duplication and potential security oversights.
rootCause: The validateAndBuildWithDefaults method does not inspect or copy the gRPC metadata provider configuration from the reused channel.
proposedFix: Enhance validateAndBuildWithDefaults to automatically carry over grpcMetadataProvider configuration from the source channel unless explicitly overridden.
workaround: Explicitly set the grpcMetadataProvider again when building OperatorServiceStubsOptions.
keyQuote: request is to carry over this info in ServiceStubOptions.validateAndBuildWithDefaults if possible.
